definitions.gloss: more, all the more, even more
definitions.explanation: To an even greater degree than before.

examples.japanese: {一層|いっそう}⟦{努力|どりょく}します→努力する：03490_doryoku⟧。
⟦{雨|あめ}→雨：00583_ame⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{一層|いっそう}⟦{寒|さむ}くなった→寒い：00664_samui⟧。
examples.english: The rain made it even colder.

examples.japanese: ⟦{夜|よる}→夜：00487_yoru⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なると→なる：01970_naru⟧{一層|いっそう}⟦{静|しず}かになる→静か：00755_shizuka⟧。
examples.english: It becomes even quieter at night.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{経験|けいけん}→経験：01179_keiken⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦おかげで→おかげ：01362_okage⟧⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{一層|いっそう}⟦{自信|じしん}→自信：10143_jishin⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{持|も}つようになり→持つ：00478_motsu⟧、⟦{仕事|しごと}→仕事：00480_shigoto⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦{積極的|せっきょくてき}に→積極的：01585_sekkyokuteki⟧⟦{取|と}り{組|く}んでいる→取り組む：04225_torikumu⟧。
examples.english: Thanks to this experience, he became even more confident and is now actively engaged in his work.

{一層|いっそう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{発展|はってん}→発展：03561_hatten⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{願|ねが}います→願う：02387_negau⟧。
{一層|いっそう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧ご⟦{協力|きょうりょく}→協力：00261_kyouryoku⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦お{願|ねが}いします→お願い：10299_onegai⟧。
examples.english: We ask for your further cooperation.

examples.japanese: ⟦{練習|れんしゅう}→練習：05323_renshuu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{重|かさ}ねて→重ねる：02039_kasaneru⟧{一層|いっそう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{上達|じょうたつ}→上達：03346_joutatsu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{目指|めざ}している→目指す：10528_mezasu⟧。

examples.english: I want to learn from this failure and continue to make further efforts.

notes:
{一層|いっそう} emphasizes an increase in degree.

USAGE:
- Formal/literary compared to もっと
- Often used in writing and formal speech
- Emphasizes intensification

SIMILAR WORDS:
- もっと: more (conversational, common)
- さらに: furthermore, additionally
- {一層|いっそう}: all the more (formal, emphatic)
